title: What the county government does with its money
text: Kern County's government spent about 2.6 billion dollars in 2022. It had about 10,000 full-time employees that year. Property taxes brought in about 423 million dollars of its tax revenue. An elected board of five supervisors, serving four-year terms, governs the county.
